subject: mathematics
concept: Adding and subtracting fractions with related (unlike) denominators
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student converts one set of virtual fraction tiles to match the other's denominator before combining
exercise.pictorial: Student redraws a bar model to a common denominator before adding/subtracting
exercise.abstract: Student finds a common denominator and solves addition/subtraction problems with unlike denominators

misconception_flags: adds numerators and denominators directly without finding a common denominator

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
